description: The nonexistent-wall-time rule names two different resolutions. Shifting 02:30 forward by a one-hour DST gap yields 03:30, while choosing the first valid wall time yields 03:00. Both satisfy part of the sentence and produce different start_at values and included rows; the New York spring fixture has no literal expected instant to disambiguate them. Iteration-1 FIND-003 is therefore not materially closed.

evidence.snippet: For a nonexistent local wall time, shift forward by the DST gap to the first valid wall time.
